description:
Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at later.com.

About this position:

Later is looking for a strategic, entrepreneurial Senior Director to build and lead our media measurement practice, with a focus on social and creator marketing. Sitting within Performance Media in our Services organization, you'll help brands understand how paid amplification and organic creator programs influence brand perception, retail sales, and consumer behavior. You'll partner with Performance Media, Managed Services, Strategy, and Client Success to shape measurement from pre-sale planning through study delivery and client recommendations.

This is a builder role: you'll take immediate ownership of active brand lift studies across simulated and natural exposure methodologies, then expand our offering across retail and sales lift, incrementality, visitation, and creative effectiveness. You'll initially operate as an individual contributor, personally leading study design, execution, and interpretation with support from an established Performance Media team. As the practice scales, you'll have the opportunity to build and shape a dedicated measurement team.

What you'll be doing:

Measurement Strategy

  • Own Later's media effectiveness strategy across paid social and organic creator marketing, connecting campaign objectives to measurable brand and business outcomes.
  • Define when and how to use brand lift, retail sales measurement, sales lift, incrementality testing, visitation studies, and creative effectiveness research based on client objectives, budget, and study feasibility.

 

  • Develop measurement approaches for key verticals, including online and offline sales impact for CPG and retail brands and foot traffic for location-based businesses.
  • Establish a preferred measurement partner ecosystem and a roadmap for scaling commercially viable measurement offerings.

Study Design & Execution

  • Take immediate ownership of existing brand lift programs, including simulated and natural exposure studies, from research brief and questionnaire design through fieldwork, interpretation, and client delivery.
  • Lead retail sales, sales lift, visitation, and creative effectiveness studies, coordinating with measurement partners and media teams on data requirements, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Design and oversee incrementality tests using appropriate test and control approaches, including randomized holdouts or matched-market designs where feasible.
  • Build repeatable study workflows, quality controls, measurement benchmarks, and reporting standards that improve consistency and turnaround times.
  • Translate study findings into clear client recommendations on creator selection, creative strategy, audience approach, and media investment, explaining what each methodology can and cannot establish.

Client & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Sales and Strategy to scope and price credible measurement plans for client proposals, setting clear expectations for study requirements and deliverables.
  • Embed measurement into campaign planning with Performance Media, Managed Services, and Client Success so objectives, exposure requirements, and test conditions are established before launch.
  • Collaborate with Research, Data, and technical partners on study-specific survey, exposure, and sales data requirements, and equip client teams to explain findings accurately.

Practice Leadership & Development

  • Build the practice's operating model, priorities, and delivery standards while personally leading studies and resolving methodological challenges.
  • Evaluate, negotiate, and manage third-party measurement partnerships, balancing methodological rigor, study quality, cost, scalability, and client value.
  • Define future resource needs and recruit, develop, and lead measurement specialists as client demand and investment in the practice grow.
  • Advance Later's capabilities through developments in social platform measurement, experimentation, retail measurement, and privacy-conscious research, introducing solutions that address clear client needs.

What success looks like:

  • First 30 days: Active brand lift studies have clear ownership, delivery plans, and quality expectations, with priority improvements identified across methodology, workflows, and client communication.
  • First 90 days: Repeatable brand lift workflows and study design, interpretation, and partner-management standards are in place, supported by a prioritized roadmap for retail sales measurement, incrementality, and creative testing.
  • By 6 months: Priority measurement offerings have defined methodologies, preferred partners, scoping and pricing guidance, and delivery processes, with initial studies launched where client demand and feasibility support them.
  • By 12 months: Later has a scalable media measurement practice that delivers credible evidence of brand and business impact, informs client investment decisions, and has a clear resourcing plan, with dedicated hiring aligned to business demand.

What you bring:

We are committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. If your experience aligns with this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

  • Progressive experience leading media effectiveness, advertising research, or marketing science programs, with ownership of strategy, study delivery, and senior client relationships at a Director or Senior Director scope.
  • Deep expertise in survey-based brand lift research, including simulated and natural exposure methodologies, questionnaire design, sampling, statistical interpretation, and study limitations.
  • Direct experience with retail sales measurement, sales lift, and incrementality testing, including selecting appropriate test and control approaches and interpreting online and offline sales outcomes. Experience with visitation studies and creative effectiveness research is also valuable.
  • Experience evaluating and managing third-party measurement providers, including methodology assessment, commercial negotiations, and study delivery. Familiarity with ThisThat, Circana, ABCS Insights, InMarket, Samba TV, Precisely / PlaceIQ, or comparable providers is an asset.
  • The research and statistical judgment to personally lead studies, assess data quality, challenge unsupported conclusions, and translate findings into clear recommendations for clients and internal teams.
  • Proven success building measurement capabilities, workflows, service offerings, or teams, with an entrepreneurial approach to ambiguity and the ability to establish the foundation as an individual contributor before scaling a team.
  • Strong client communication and cross-functional leadership, with the ability to shape proposals, explain methodological tradeoffs, influence stakeholders, and develop measurement talent. Experience tailoring programs to CPG, retail, entertainment, or other consumer verticals is a plus.

How we work:

  • We will do whatever it takes to win: We win when our customers and creators win. We bring full commitment to outcomes that matter, not just effort.
  • We have no limit to our aspiration: We think big, push beyond what seems possible, and refuse to let conventional thinking set the ceiling.
  • We are relentless: We keep going. Through ambiguity, setbacks, and competing priorities, we find a way forward.
  • We deeply understand our business: If we don't have the knowledge, we figure it out. We take ownership of understanding how Later works and what drives results.
  • We take our work seriously, but not ourselves: We bring rigor and accountability without ego, and we make space for each other to do our best work.

Our approach to compensation:

We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted.

Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

Salary Range: $160-200k

Where we work:

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located. 

Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility:

At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit. We openly build and maintain unbiased hiring, pay, and promotion practices to create a foundation for an equitable workplace, paving the way for systemic change.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or age. Please let us know if you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process.
